final_goal: A clean, reproducible, deployment-valid, continuously improving Skat AI system that autonomously acquires/validates data, trains challengers, evaluates scientifically, rejects/promotes by evidence, recovers, validates externally, packages releases, integrates through one stable SkatAI interface, and operates FULL-AFK.
north_star: Reproducibly accepted deployment-valid Skat playing strength per useful compute, model cost, and wall-clock time.

goal_path.purpose: Trusted, leakage-safe, versioned data and evidence.
ACCEPT/REJECT/INCONCLUSIVE and atomic promotion or incumbent retention.
Reproducible release packaging and stable Skat software integration.
Verified autonomous recovery, cost control, and unattended operation.
Continuous weakness mining and scientifically gated improvement loop.

primary_selection.rule: Choose the single unresolved consequential gate with the greatest verified contribution to the shortest valid path from current state to the final goal. Prefer a real blocker/decision boundary over adjacent polish.

background_work.rule: Long-running scientifically valid jobs run under independent supervisors and do not consume MAIN model attention while healthy.

evidence_guard.mutable_state: Verify current state directly before material action; stale narrative is not authority.
evidence_guard.unsupported_claim: Classify UNKNOWN and perform the smallest bounded verification. Never act as though an inferred fact were verified.
evidence_guard.material_effects: Before external/provisioning/deletion/promotion/training-launch/ISS effects, verify identity, current state, authorization, and duplicate-effect risk.
evidence_guard.followup_evidence: Every autonomous follow-up requires at least one controller-verifiable evidence path under the V2 repository or runtime.

loop_guard.rule: Do not repeat the same primary gate + next action + evidence signature. Repetition without new verified evidence is a loop and must hold autonomously.
